purpose: Replace role-name/expert-seeded allocation with demonstrated task evidence as repeat receipts accumulate, while keeping PCA/BT fail-closed until their denominators are sufficient.
demonstrated_level_rule: For a crew+competency dimension, use the minimum predeclared task level across accepted gate-eligible receipts; this is deliberately conservative.

reverse_pressure.persistent_rex: penalize repeating the same unsupported crew/resource pattern and raise target priority for the missing prevention capability
reverse_pressure.high_queue_or_wait: route to runtime/performance resource intervention before assuming competence deficit
reverse_pressure.rejection: increase repair/training/challenge pressure; never infer lower competence if rejection is caused by external habitat without evidence
reverse_pressure.repeat_accept: increase measured allocation confidence for the demonstrated competency dimension

promotion_boundary: Allocation eligibility is not competency promotion. Registry maturity/level changes remain governed by COMPETENCY_MATRIX_v1 promotion rules and explicit authority gates.
